title: usb-rea generates a Linux driver for your Windows-only USB gadget
summary:
usb-rea is an MIT-licensed tool for people who own a USB gadget that only ships with a Windows program. It captures packets while you use the Windows app and generates a pyusb driver for Linux. Many years ago, I had to reverse-engineer a USB video capture card, whose vendor didn’t want to work with a company specializing in “small-volume production”. I had to capture the packets with Wireshark and manually implement code to replay URB (USB Request Block) packets using libusb, while paying close attention to timings. A tool like usb-rea would have been useful at the time. More specifically, usb-rea captures USB traffic with USBPcap or usbmon while the user clicks through the vendor app and labels the actions. The open-source program then infers the command structure (constants, counters, value fields, lookup tables, CRCs) and writes a Markdown protocol report plus a standalone Linux driver. The developer, Emir Mrkaljevic, [...]

title: TinyWifiDongle Arduino library turns ESP32-S3 and Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W boards into USB WiFi adapters
summary:
TinyWifiDongle open-source Arduino library turns ESP32-S2/S3 and Raspberry Pi Pico W/2 W boards into USB WiFi adapters. The library uses USB CDC-NCM (Network Control Model) to provide network connectivity to Linux, macOS, and Windows 11 computers without installing additional drivers. The library implements a transparent Layer-2 bridge between the MCU’s WiFi and USB interfaces, allowing the connected computer to get an IP address directly from the router via DHCP, without NAT or a separate network. It supports hard-coded WiFi credentials or browser-based configuration and achieves approximately 5 Mbps on the ESP32-S3 and 2 Mbps on the Pico 2 W in the developer’s tests. TinyWifiDongle overview: Supported hardware ESP32-S3 and ESP32-S2 with native USB-OTG support; tested on ESP32-S3 Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W (RP2350) and Pico W (RP2040); tested on Pico 2 W ESP32-P4 (+ESP32-C6) support is experimental, with USB networking not yet tested USB networking – USB CDC-NCM using TinyUSB [...]
